items.title: Prato: Arroz parboilizado cozido + Ovo inteiro cozido + Repolho cru
items.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative meal photograph for a nutrition recipe catalog. Primary request: a realistic appetizing serving containing ONLY these named catalog foods (names in Brazilian Portuguese): Arroz parboilizado cozido; Ovo inteiro cozido; Repolho cru. Arrange the three foods in adjacent sections in a white ceramic shallow bowl.
